read.thesis: MUFG raised FY ending Mar-2027 profit target to ¥2,800.0bn from ¥2,700.0bn (+3.7%), and lifted year-end dividend to ¥100 from ¥96 annual, on customer segment progress and Morgan Stanley equity earnings.

triggers.label: Profit target raised ¥100bn to ¥2,800bn
triggers.quote: we have upwardly revised the earnings target for profits attributable to owners of parent by ¥100 billion, setting it at ¥2,800 billion.

triggers.label: Year-end dividend ¥48 → ¥52
triggers.quote: MUFG has revised its year-end dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 from ¥48.00 to ¥52.00 per share.
